title: Your first campaign, start to finish

vo: Here's your first WhatsApp campaign, from start to finish.
Step one. Connect your WhatsApp number, through Meta's official signup.
Step two. Describe your message. AI writes it, and Meta approves it.
Step three. Import your contacts, and pick a segment.
Step four. Switch on the AI agent, retries, and SMS fallback.
Step five. Go live, and watch it deliver in real time.
Five steps. No code. Start free with Spandan today.
